item.text: I’m reviewing the current structure again and looking for the next real design improvement rather than another superficial split. The most likely target is the result/collection API, which still exposes indexed lookups and raw lists more than it should.

I’m tightening the collection boundary now. The aim is to make result/component objects iterable domain values instead of thin wrappers around exposed lists, so formatting and tests stop reaching into their internal storage.

The iterable boundary refactor is in. I’m compiling and running the app and tests now to verify the new traversal/formatting access pattern behaves the same and that the immutability checks still hold through iterators.
The compile and regression run are clean. I’m pulling line references from the updated files so the summary can point directly to the new iterable API and the test changes.

Refactored the result model so `ConnectedComponent` and `ConnectedComponentsResult` behave like iterable domain objects instead of list wrappers. [ConnectedComponent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ConnectedComponent.java:5) now implements `Iterable<Vertex>` and exposes focused accessors like `isEmpty()` and `vertexAt(...)`. [ConnectedComponentsResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ConnectedComponentsResult.java:6) does the same for components, adding `isEmpty()` and hiding the old raw-list accessor.

That let [ComponentFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ComponentFormatter.java:6) switch from index-based loops to direct iteration, which is a better fit for the domain model and reduces internal list coupling. I also updated [ConnectedComponentsTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/027_connected_components/ConnectedComponentsTest.java:18) so it verifies behavior through iteration and checks immutability through iterator removal rather than mutating exposed lists.

Verified with `javac *.java`, `java ConnectedComponents`, and `java ConnectedComponentsTest`.
